reviewer: Independent second editor /root/completion_build_review; authored assembly/navigation code, not learner-facing pages or artwork
inspection_method: Reopened immutable proof, rendered every requested page to PNG with MuPDF at120dpi, then viewed all25 full-page images at readable size. Consulted source and extracted PDF text for specific track and provenance questions. No source or PDF edits during review. Final follow-ups rendered and viewed four changed intermediate pages and two final progress pages at120dpi; independently recomputed complete pixel comparisons against both earlier proofs to retain unchanged review coverage.

page_judgments.judgment: Saturated magenta/gold and strong title hierarchy feel like a coherent adult course book. Cyclist, helmet, handlebars, both wheels and feet are visible; the scene gives a genuine horizon rather than a generic portrait.
Clear title, level, author and school identity. Imprint is readable, avoids fabricated ISBN/platform claims and directs image/media provenance to the end.
All four units and both paired reviews fit in a clear ruled table; long title/vocabulary wraps remain readable and each page locator has a stable right edge.
Units5–8 and the reference-section directory remain readable. Complete row boundaries and generous title hierarchy keep a dense page navigable.
A/C language, B reading/listening and D productive work are easy to distinguish. Six actual learning/navigation features explain the book without decorative clutter or invented resources.

Prominent QR and real course URL, short numbered instructions, actual track example and useful study guidance. Offline PDF wording correctly distinguishes online audio. Class-game copy describes reserved spaces rather than claiming live games.

Four functional phrase groups show natural complete exchanges. Helpful clarification/turn-taking phrases and a full response line give the page a real transfer purpose. Study-kit cutout is complete and task-serving.

American alphabet-name groups are accurate; stressed word parts are clear. Gets/goes/watches and the six-ed examples illustrate correct pronunciation groups. Table rules and model emphasis are readable with no clipped IPA glyphs.

Accurate irregular forms and complete examples; clear regular spelling models include walked/lived/studied/planned. Two-column past be models are aligned. Reference scope stays with course language rather than adding an unexplained participle column.
Units1–4 use meaningful communicative can-do goals, distinct response circles, room for a personal example and a next-step field. It checks usable learning rather than just completion.
Units5–8 goals map to shopping, directions, past narrative and travel/ticket communication. Repeated self-assessment structure is appropriate, with clear unit boundaries and visible writing fields.

29 compact topic rows have readable labels and clear lesson/practice columns. Topic wording is indexing rather than compressed grammar exposition; line spacing is consistent and last row remains safely above footer.
A–fish page: readable three-column alphabetical route, visible letter dividers and strongly distinguished page locators. Long useful phrases remain intact.
Fit–name page: continued alphabet headings, repeated locators and mixed word/phrase entries are readable. No collision across columns.
New–studied page: word entries, multi-page locators and continued letter groups fit comfortably; right edges are consistent.
Study–Zz page: wrapped ticket/phone phrases keep their locators visible; remaining alphabet and ordinal entries fit without cutting the bottom.

Units1–4 split into readable tables. Recording names and page locations distinguish the two track1.8 files; explanatory footer resolves the numbering exception. Unit2 non-narrative track ordering preserves the published track IDs rather than pretending they are activity numbers.
Units5–8 tables are balanced and readable. PDF text confirms separate5.11 and5.12 rows. Track/page columns remain sufficiently distinct and the long labels do not cross rules.
A clean useful notebook page with evenly spaced full-width writing rules and visible margins; the page is writable rather than overdecorated.
Matching notebook page with complete lines and safe footer clearance. Line spacing is appropriate for handwriting; no line extends outside the page body.
Readable linked names/licenses with explicit source page numbers and a clear introductory provenance note. No entry is truncated.
Two credit columns remain readable; the longer Commons crop explanation fits in its row without encroaching on the next credit.
Source/licence links, Commons attribution and crop note fit. White space is suitable for an end reference page rather than forced instructional content.
Long attribution and image-change notes wrap cleanly. Generated-art disclosure now includes cover and study-kit pages4/152 plus the author-supplied Wingfield mark; full text fits above footer.

Saturated series identity, true8-unit/4-review claims and practical-reference summary. Horizons on Air is mentioned and the online-access QR has a clear quiet zone. Logo and author line are complete; no fake barcode, access code or app badge.

overall_decision: PASS for final449ee8eb edition; all25 requested pages covered through initial full review, four-page intermediate review, two-page final recheck and independently verified pixel transfer. No remaining editorial or page-fit blockers.
strengths: Adult course-book identity with saturated colour and restrained editorial references.
Course-specific contents, study guidance and meaningful progress goals.
Readable complete grammar/pronunciation examples without the prohibited compressed prose style.
Useful searchable-looking word/grammar/audio references and genuinely writable notes.
Real digital resource claims and attributable end matter without invented commercial identifiers.

nonblocking_consistency_observations.observation: New pages contain verb practise although source language is en-US and the pronunciation reference explicitly uses American English.
nonblocking_consistency_observations.suggestion: For a consistent American English house style, use practice as the verb too.

nonblocking_consistency_observations.observation: Back cover presents HORIZONS ON AIR as a single black badge rather than the split black HORIZONS and magenta ON AIR identity used by the episodes.
nonblocking_consistency_observations.suggestion: Reusing the canonical two-part mark would strengthen series branding. The current wording remains readable and truthful.

limitations: This independent editorial review covers the25 new/modified pages, not a new proof of all147 unchanged teaching pages.
Root owns numerical line-spacing, link destinations, QR decoding, bookmarks, audio-link resolution, preservation and live deployment checks; those claims are not substituted for visual judgment here.
No new subjective audio-quality assessment or full rights-ownership investigation was performed.

intermediate_review.method: All four viewed as saved-PDF120dpi full-page PNGs.
intermediate_review.findings: Guide practice spelling and canonical split Horizons on Air back-cover mark pass. Progress body copy passes, but capitalized Practise again remained in eight column headings; root notified for final copy correction.

final_followup.judgment: All eight column headings now read Practice again. Body copy, response circles, unit boundaries, personal-example fields and next-step lines remain clear with no lost writing space or clipped text.
retained_from_intermediate: Guide printed3: complete American practice spelling and readable feature explanations.
Back cover: canonical two-part Horizons on Air mark is clear, with no other branding/layout changes.
